description: What do US pharmacies pay for this drug? CMS’s National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) per unit for an NDC, the generic’s NADAC for a brand and the weekly price history since January 2025, from CMS’s NADAC files on data.medicaid.gov. From CMS’s weekly NADAC files on data.medicaid.gov (2025 on): the current per-unit NADAC of one NDC, its effective date and explanation codes, the corresponding generic’s NADAC for a brand, the range over NDCs with the same description, and every price period since January 2025. An NDC never listed answers 404 and is not charged; one no longer listed answers with listed: false and its last NADAC. Updated weekly. Price: $0.01 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Freshness only (the values are CMS’s, read deterministically): 1 until 9 days after the latest weekly file’s as-of date, then halving every 14 days. National Average Drug Acquisition Cost as CMS publishes it weekly: a survey average of what retail pharmacies pay per unit, not a retail price, a reimbursement rate, a quote or medical advice. See /terms.
